8: He that did an act intentionally does not go into exile - A killer that did a deed, if he acted with intent, he does not go into exile, and even in a situation (lit. a time) that he is not killed, for example it was premeditated, (but) without (appropriate) warning (by witnesses):

They (the false witnesses) that did not do a deed - Rather (their action) was only verbal, and (although) their testimony was premeditated, is it not logical they should not go into exile for their premeditated intention:
